stem.en: A tanpura string sounds a note with a fundamental of 250 Hz. Then it is played so that its fundamental is 500 Hz, just as loudly. Which statement is true?

text.en: The second note is an octave higher, and it travels twice as fast through the air.
The second note is an octave higher, and it travels at the same speed through the air.
The second note is the same note, played twice as loudly.
The second note is not an octave higher, because an octave is a change in loudness.

explanation.en: 500 Hz is double 250 Hz, so the second note is an octave higher. In the same air, sound travels at the same speed whatever its frequency.

hints.en: Does the speed of sound in air depend on the frequency?
